description: This file implements the context management for distributed autograd in PyTorch, including functions for handling gradients, RPCs, and context-specific data structures.

classes.name: DistAutogradContext
classes.description: Manages distributed autograd context including gradients, RPCs, and associated data.

classes.name: ThreadLocalDistAutogradContext
classes.description: Handles thread-local context switching for distributed autograd.

methods.name: addKnownWorkerId
methods.description: Adds a worker ID to the known set.

methods.name: addSendFunction
methods.description: Associates a send RPC backward function with an autograd message ID.

methods.name: addRecvFunction
methods.description: Associates a receive RPC backward function with an autograd message ID.

methods.name: accumulateGrad
methods.description: Accumulates gradient for a variable in distributed autograd.

methods.name: addOutstandingRpc
methods.description: Adds an outstanding RPC to the context.

methods.name: recordGradEvent
methods.description: Records a CUDA event for gradient readiness.

methods.name: clearAndWaitForOutstandingRpcsAsync
methods.description: Returns a future that completes after all outstanding RPCs are finished.

methods.name: retrieveSendFunction
methods.description: Retrieves a send function by autograd message ID.

methods.name: getGradients
methods.description: Returns the accumulated gradients, blocking streams to ensure completion.

methods.name: runGradCallbackForVariable
methods.description: Runs a callback for a variable's gradient and updates the gradient map.
